chants.notes: Printed 'IN. Nos autem gloriari oportet, 162, cum psalmo 141 :' — psalm-tone plan, not modeled. The introit antiphon is cited to p162; the GR engraves only its psalm-verse tone (mode IV) below the citation on p613: 'Ps. Voce mea ad Dominum clamo, voce mea ad Dominum deprecor. Ant. Nos autem.' Its verse list, 'Ps. 141*, 2. 3. 4. 6. 7 ab. 7 cd. 8 ab. 8 cd', is printed at the top of p614 below the CO. line.
This citation shares one merged text block (y40.8-63.1) with the following CO. line; the band [39,64] covers both — do not subdivide.
